'''The Star''' is an inn in the city of [[Tear]] run by [[Jurah Haret]].  

[[Perrin]], [[Loial]], [[Moiraine]], [[Lan]] and [[Faile]] stay there when they arrive in Tear, chasing after [[Rand]]. There is a weaver's shop on one side and a smithy on the other which combined make the inn quite noisy. It stands four stories tall and has small windows in its roof as well.{{ref/book|3|50}} Perrin worked in the smithy run by [[Dermid Ajala]] while Moiraine was looking for Rand.
